home.title: Will solar pay off on your roof?
home.lead: Answer a few questions and add a photo of your electricity bill. You'll see the right system size for your home, usually within two minutes.

form.roofLegend: What is your roof made of?
form.roofArea: Roof area you could use, in sq ft
form.roofAreaHint: A rough guess is fine. A 20 × 30 ft terrace is 600 sq ft.
form.name: Your name
form.phoneHint: 10 digits. We'll send updates here on WhatsApp.
form.consentLabel: I agree that Company A can use my details for this purpose.
form.consentNotice: Company A uses your name, phone, address details, electricity bill and any roof you mark on the map to check if solar suits your home, prepare your quote, and update you on your project. You can ask us to delete them at any time.
form.tooMany: Too many tries from this connection. Wait a few minutes, then try again.
form.failed: Your details did not save. Check your connection and try again.
form.measureRoof: Not sure? Measure your roof on a map
form.roofMeasured: Measured on the map: {area} sq ft

errors.roofArea: Enter an area between 50 and 1,00,000 sq ft.
errors.monthlyBill: Enter your bill in rupees, for example 2500.
errors.name: Enter your name.
errors.phone: Enter a 10-digit mobile number starting with 6, 7, 8 or 9.
errors.consent: Tick the box so we can use your details for this.

upload.title: Add your electricity bill
upload.lead: A photo of the front is enough. Add the back if you can, as the arrears and charges are usually there.
upload.choose: Take a photo or choose a file
upload.formats: JPG, PNG, WEBP or PDF, up to 4 MB
upload.readingHint: This usually takes a few seconds.
upload.manual: I don't have my bill with me
upload.samplesTitle: Trying this out? Use a sample bill
upload.tooLarge: That file is over 4 MB. Take a new photo or choose a smaller file.
upload.badType: That file type won't work. Use a JPG, PNG, WEBP or PDF.
upload.rateLimited: Too many uploads. Wait a few minutes, then try again.
upload.failed: The upload did not finish. Check your connection and try again.

issue.blurry: This photo looks blurry. Hold the phone still and tap the bill to focus.
issue.dark: This photo looks dark. Move near a window or a light.
issue.small: This photo is very small. Move closer so the bill fills the frame.

check.title: Check what we read
check.lead: Correct anything that doesn't match your bill. Highlighted values are the ones we're less sure of.
check.manualLead: Automatic reading isn't available right now, so please type these in. Your details are saved and nothing else changes.
check.noBillLead: Type in what you know. We'll check the rest with you later.
check.invalid: Check the highlighted values and try again.

poorTitle.notBill: That doesn't look like an electricity bill
poorTitle.blurry: That photo is too blurry to read
poorTitle.cropped: Part of the bill is cut off
poorTitle.dark: That photo is too dark to read

check.poorLead: Your details are saved. A clearer photo gets you an accurate result, so please try once more.
check.tip1: Lay the bill flat on a table, in good light.
check.tip2: Fit the whole first page in the frame.
check.tip3: Hold the phone steady and tap to focus before you shoot.

result.nextCall: We'll call you within one working day. It takes about five minutes.

quote.title: Your solar quote
quote.howSubsidyNone: No subsidy applies to this connection.
quote.howSubsidyCap: Capped at the scheme limit of {cap}.
quote.howGeneration: {kw} kW × {factor} units per kW a year = {units} units
quote.howSavings: {offset} units × {tariff} per unit (your tariff){surplus} = {savings} a year
quote.howLifetime: {savings} × 25 years − {net} = {total}. Assumes today's tariff and steady output.
quote.payLead: An advance of {amount} confirms your {kw} kW system and starts your project.
quote.payNote: This is a demo: no money moves.
quote.notFoundLead: Check the link in your WhatsApp message, or call us.

status.done: Your project is complete. Your subsidy has been credited.
status.uploadFailed: That upload didn't work. Use a JPG, PNG, WEBP or PDF under 4 MB.
status.noDocs: Nothing is needed from you right now.
status.forecastHistory: Based on {count} finished projects like yours.
status.forecastLimits: Based on our usual time for each stage.
status.savingsLead: Add a bill and we'll check it against your quote.

stageNext.ADVANCE_RECEIVED: We'll list the documents we need from you, usually within a day.
stageNext.DOCUMENTS: Upload the documents below. We'll then book your installation date.
stageNext.INSTALLATION_SCHEDULED: Our team will install your system on the booked date.
stageNext.INSTALLED: We'll test the system and apply for your net meter with the electricity company.
stageNext.NET_METERING_APPLIED: The electricity company reviews the application and fits your net meter.
stageNext.NET_METER_INSTALLED: We'll apply for your subsidy on your behalf.
stageNext.SUBSIDY_APPLIED: The subsidy is paid directly to your bank account once approved.
stageNext.SUBSIDY_CREDITED: Nothing more to do. Enjoy your lower bills.

outbox.leadReceived: Hello {name}, thanks for your details. Company A Solar will call you within one working day.
outbox.quoteSent: Hello {name}, your solar quote for {kw} kW is ready. See it here: {link}
outbox.stage: Hello {name}, your solar project has moved to: {stage}. Next: {next} Track it here: {link}
outbox.savingsBehind: Hello {name}, your {month} bill is higher than we promised. We're checking your system and will call you.

login.title: Sign in
login.lead: Homeowners use their mobile number. Staff use their work email.
login.error: That login or password isn't right.

my.empty: No enquiries linked to this account yet.

error.title: Something went wrong on our side

roofMap.tapCorners: Find your house, then tap each corner of the roof.
roofMap.notFound: We couldn't find that place. Try a nearby landmark, or move the map yourself.
roofMap.crossed: The lines cross. Undo the last corner and go round the roof in order.
roofMap.tooBig: That is larger than a house roof. Zoom in until you can see your roof, then mark it again.

year.title: Your bills, before and after solar
year.savingLine: That saves about {amount} a year on the published MSEDCL slabs.
year.surplusLine: This includes {amount} for spare units left on 31 March.
year.chartLabel: Your electricity use each month against what the panels would make
year.estimateNote: Your bill did not print this month, so we estimated it from the season.

basis.BILL_HISTORY: Based on the months printed on your bill.
basis.PARTIAL_HISTORY: Based on the months on your bill. Lighter bars are our estimate for the rest.
basis.ONE_MONTH: Based on one bill. Lighter bars are our estimate from the seasons.

year.tariffNote: Slab rates from {tariff}, in force from {date}. Fixed charges stay, so a bill never reaches zero.
year.quoteNote: The figures above use one simple rate per unit, so they stay easy to check. This is the same system on your real slabs.
year.seasonAbove: This bill is {percent}% above your normal month, so we sized your system on the whole year.
year.seasonBelow: This bill is {percent}% below your normal month, so we sized your system on the whole year.
year.poorTitle: Solar may not be worth it for you
year.poorLead: Your use is low, so you pay the cheapest rates. Solar would take about {years} years to pay for itself. We would rather tell you now. A short call can check if your use will grow.

blockers.title: Fix these before we start
blockers.lead: These can hold up your subsidy or net meter. Sorting them now saves weeks later.

nameMismatch.title: The bill is in the name of {onBill}
nameMismatch.fix: The subsidy goes to the person named on the connection. Apply in that name, or change the name with MSEDCL first.

arrears.title: {amount} is overdue on this bill
arrears.fix: Clear this first. MSEDCL can hold a net meter application while dues are unpaid.

loadLow.title: Your sanctioned load is {loadKw} kW, but you could use {wantedKw} kW
loadLow.fix: Your system can't be larger than your load. You can ask MSEDCL to raise the load, and we can help with the form.

nonResidential.title: This is not a home tariff
nonResidential.fix: The central subsidy is for homes, so we will quote without it.

tenant.title: You are renting this property
tenant.fix: The owner must agree in writing, and the bill must be in the right name for a subsidy.

alreadySolar.title: This bill already shows solar export
alreadySolar.fix: This connection seems to have a net meter. We will check before planning any more panels.

meterFault.title: Meter status on the bill: {status}
meterFault.fix: Ask MSEDCL to check the meter first, as billed units may not be accurate.

card.title: Share with your family
card.lead: One picture with the numbers that matter, to send on WhatsApp.
card.imageLabel: A summary of your solar quote as an image
card.heading: Solar plan for {name}
card.footer: Quote of {date}. Prices are confirmed after the roof survey.
